phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Sten Mk II Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 9×19mm Parabellum primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 235 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 235 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 196 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 365 m/s (535 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Open-Bolt Slam & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 32-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Sten Mk II staged for its 550 RPM (Cross-Bolt Semi / Full-Auto Selector) cadence.

zh.headline: 司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪：1941 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 敦刻尔克大撤退后仅用 36 天诞生的司登 Mk II 以“水管与冲压铁皮”极限降本闻名：全枪仅 47 个零件、单支成本不足 11 美元；横置弹匣座可旋转 90° 封口防尘，二战期间空投遍及欧洲反法西斯游击队。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Sten Mk II 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1941 年问世的 司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 由英国恩菲尔德皇家轻武器厂（RSAF Enfield）主导研制，定位为经典的管状机匣战时冲锋枪。“STEN”之名取自设计师谢泼德（Shepherd）、特平（Turpin）及恩菲尔德厂（Enfield）首字母，各型二战总产量超过 400 万支。
敦刻尔克大撤退后仅用 36 天诞生的司登 Mk II 以“水管与冲压铁皮”极限降本闻名：全枪仅 47 个零件、单支成本不足 11 美元；横置弹匣座可旋转 90° 封口防尘，二战期间空投遍及欧洲反法西斯游击队。 整件装备总长 762 mm（快拆 T 型或环形钢架托）、空重 3.18 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1941 年，英国恩菲尔德皇家轻武器厂（RSAF Enfield）推出了划时代的司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪。“STEN”之名取自设计师谢泼德（Shepherd）、特平（Turpin）及恩菲尔德厂（Enfield）首字母，各型二战总产量超过 400 万支。 它的核心设计聚焦于全枪仅 47 个极简部件，任意自行车厂或五金冲压作坊均可批量制造，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「自由枪机 · 开膛待击 + 左侧横置 32 发弹匣与极简管式机匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。左侧水平插槽弹匣座可绕管状机匣旋转 90° 充当行军防尘封口，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 采用自由枪机 · 开膛待击 + 左侧横置 32 发弹匣与极简管式机匣。在每个击发周期中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了左侧水平插槽弹匣座可绕管状机匣旋转 90° 充当行军防尘封口。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 9×19mm Parabellum 弹药规格与 196 mm · 6 条右旋膛线（1:254 mm，战时亦产 2 线简化管），最高工作膛压约 235 MPa，可赋予弹头 365 m/s 的出膛初速与 535 J 动能，有效作用距离达 100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，旋转弹匣座即可兼作防尘盖；枪管组件仅需旋松多孔护筒即可徒手分解。同时，通吃 9×19mm 弹药并兼容缴获德军弹药，极大缓解敌后游击队补给压力，令其在 550 发/分（推钮式单发 / 全自动快慢机） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 196 毫米身管与 9×19mm Parabellum 口径，司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 实现了每秒 365 米的初速与 100 米有效射程。旋转弹匣座即可兼作防尘盖；枪管组件仅需旋松多孔护筒即可徒手分解，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 32 发容量的32 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 35 mm 膛轴设计，司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4 N·s 水平。旋卸式枪管护筒与卡扣金属托可瞬间拆成三段隐蔽携行与空投。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-63）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 32 发容量的32 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，旋卸式枪管护筒与卡扣金属托可瞬间拆成三段隐蔽携行与空投。欢迎在 BAY-63 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 司登 Sten Mk II 9mm 冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Sten Mk II: The 1941 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Born in 36 days after Dunkirk to re-arm Britain under siege, the Sten Mk II stripped the submachine gun down to 47 stamped and welded tubular parts costing roughly $11 each, arming Commonwealth troops and European resistance cells alike. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-63.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Sten Mk II
paragraphs: Introduced in 1941 by Royal Small Arms Factory Enfield in United Kingdom, the Sten Mk II emerged as a defining Tubular Wartime Submachine Gun. Named after designers Reginald Shepherd, Harold Turpin, and Enfield, the Sten series exceeded 4 million units built across Britain, Canada, and New Zealand.

Born in 36 days after Dunkirk to re-arm Britain under siege, the Sten Mk II stripped the submachine gun down to 47 stamped and welded tubular parts costing roughly $11 each, arming Commonwealth troops and European resistance cells alike. Measuring 762 mm (Detachable Tubular / Skeleton Stock) at an unloaded weight of 3.18 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1941, Royal Small Arms Factory Enfield of United Kingdom introduced the Sten Mk II. Named after designers Reginald Shepherd, Harold Turpin, and Enfield, the Sten series exceeded 4 million units built across Britain, Canada, and New Zealand. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Minimalist 47-part welded tube design allowed rapid manufacture in small civilian workshops — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Sten Mk II sits its Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Tubular Receiver with Side-Mounted 32-Round Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia, containing 235 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Side-mounted magazine housing pivots 90° around the tube to seal the breech against mud, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Sten Mk II relies on Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Tubular Receiver with Side-Mounted 32-Round Magazine. During each cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Side-mounted magazine housing pivots 90° around the tube to seal the breech against mud.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 9×19mm Parabellum with 196 mm · 6-Groove RH Rifling (1:254 mm; Wartime 2-Groove Variant), the Sten Mk II develops 365 m/s muzzle velocity and 535 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 100 meters.

Internally, Rotating magazine housing doubles as a dust cover; the barrel removes by unscrewing the perforated jacket by hand. Combined with its 550 RPM (Cross-Bolt Semi / Full-Auto Selector) tempo, Chambered in 9×19mm to enable use of captured German ammunition behind enemy lines, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 9×19mm Parabellum through its 196 millimeter bore, the Sten Mk II achieves 365 meters per second and 100 meters of effective reach. Rotating magazine housing doubles as a dust cover; the barrel removes by unscrewing the perforated jacket by hand.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 32-round 32-round detachable magazine body with a 35 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Unscrewing barrel shroud and snap-off stock break down cleanly for clandestine airdrop containers.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-63), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 32-round 32-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Unscrewing barrel shroud and snap-off stock break down cleanly for clandestine airdrop containers. Explore BAY-63 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Sten Mk II.
